title: Ava e Noah vão viajar
grammar: Be going to para planos de viagem (I am going to visit)
goal: Use am/is/are going to + verbo para falar de planos para o futuro.
reading: Ava and Noah are going to take a trip.
Ava e Noah vão fazer uma viagem.
They are going to visit the coast.
Ava is going to pack two small bags.
A Ava vai arrumar duas malas pequenas.
Noah is going to buy a train ticket.
O Noah vai comprar uma passagem de trem.
Noah is going to sleep on the tour bus.
O Noah vai dormir no ônibus de turismo.
dialogue: Are you going to take a trip?
Yes, I am going to the coast.
Are you going to pack tonight?
Você vai arrumar as malas hoje à noite?
Yes, I am going to pack now.
Yes, she is going to come too.
Are you going to take the tour bus?
Vocês vão pegar o ônibus de turismo?
Yes, we are going to leave at nine.
pron: Na fala, going to vira “gonna”: GOH-ning tu, com a força em going.
gram: Ava ___ going to pack two bags.
A Ava vai arrumar duas malas.
